consequences: User-facing settings expose no internal scores. Developer views show bounded真实 owner records, content-free source fingerprints, real audit receipts and observed operation durations. Unknown outcomes require reread; no automatic resend. Native credentials never enter WebView. This does not assert all domains, all admin commands or release gates complete.
context: Existing Persona and Relationship owners are implemented but desktop controls and contribution governance are missing. User explicitly requests B3 then B4 then B2.
decision: Keep domain canonical ownership. Public controls use scoped strict typed requests and owner-local transaction revision checks; agreement secrets stay inside Gateway and only allowlisted readable terms can be confirmed. Dedicated5minute main-window native capability gates exact-revision candidate rejection and contribution rollback/rebuild after explicit impact confirmation. Protected proposal approval remains unavailable through this low-disclosure surface.
title: Companion controls and exact domain governance
